choices.why: Its warm beige woven fabric, clean track arms and low, simple profile best match the request for a serene beige sofa against the right wall.
This natural jute rug at 160x230 cm is large enough to anchor both the sofa and the coffee table, and it adds organic texture against the dark floor.
This large, low, round walnut table with plain wooden legs is the purest Japandi option and echoes the sofa's dark wooden feet.
This tall rice-paper floor lantern is exactly the requested paper lamp and gives soft light in the corner by the back windows.
The braided money tree is the tallest and most sculptural plant, so it gives the large green presence wanted beside the balcony glass.

answer.why: Beige fabric, jute, walnut and rice paper form a calm, neutral palette that warms the white walls and the dark gray floor. The single tall plant brings nature in by the balcony without cluttering the minimal look.
